title: Getting Started
content:
Getting Started#Download#Die offiziellen Builds findest du auf GitHub Releases. Wähle das passende Paket für dein Betriebssystem (Windows, macOS, Linux – laut README).
Zu den Releases Installation & Start#Lade das Release für dein System herunter. Installiere oder starte die App entsprechend der Paketform (z. B. Installer/ZIP). Öffne noScribe und importiere eine Audio-/Video-Datei. Erste Transkription#Wähle Sprache und Modell. Starte die Transkription. Prüfe das Ergebnis im integrierten Editor und korrigiere bei Bedarf. Die Modell-Downloads sind groß (mehrere GB). Plane Zeit und Speicherplatz ein. (Hinweis aus dem README.) Bekannte Hinweise & Grenzen#Transkription kann langsam sein: Eine Stunde Audio kann bis zu ca. drei Stunden Rechenzeit benötigen (laut README). Starke Nebengeräusche reduzieren die Qualität. Ein Korrektur-Review ist empfehlenswert. title: Getting Started
content:
Getting Started#Download#Official builds are published on GitHub Releases. Choose the package for your operating system (Windows, macOS, Linux – per the README).
Open Releases Install & Launch#Download the release for your system. Install or unpack the app (depending on the package type). Open noScribe and import an audio/video file. First transcription#Select language and model. Start transcription. Review and correct the result in the built-in editor. Model downloads can be large (multiple GB). Plan time and disk space (as noted in the README). Known notes & limits#Transcription can be slow: one hour of audio can take up to ~three hours of processing time (per README). Heavy background noise reduces quality. A manual review pass is recommended. title: Custom Models (Whisper)
content:
Custom Models (Whisper)#Diese Seite fasst die Wiki-Anleitung zum Hinzufügen eigener Whisper-Modelle zusammen. Details und die jeweils neuesten Hinweise findest du in der Originalquelle (Link unten).
Kurzüberblick (as per wiki)#Öffne in noScribe Model > Add AI model…. Dadurch wird der Model-Ordner im Benutzerprofil geöffnet. Lege pro Modell einen eigenen Unterordner an. Der Ordnername wird im UI als Modellname angezeigt. Nur Faster-Whisper/CTranslate2-Modelle funktionieren. Modelle im Original-OpenAI-Format müssen vorher konvertiert werden. Lege die Modelldateien in den Unterordner (typisch: config.json, model.bin, preprocessor_config.json, tokenizer.json, vocabulary.json). Danach sollte das Modell in noScribe erscheinen. Pfade (as per wiki)#Windows: C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\noScribe\noScribe\whisper_models\ macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/noscribe/whisper_models/ Linux: TODO (im Wiki nicht explizit genannt) Beispielquellen für Modelle (as per wiki)#Faster-Whisper Modelle (Systran) – enthält u. a. Whisper v2 Sprachspezifische Modelle (z. B. Französisch oder Deutsch) Hinweis: Manche Downloads enthalten Dateinamen mit ctranslate2_-Prefix – diese müssen entfernt werden (z. B. ctranslate2_vocabulary.json → vocabulary.json). Für das deutschsprachige Modell wird zusätzlich tokenizer.json aus dem originalen Whisper-v3-Repository benötigt. Source#Original-Wiki: https://github.com/kaixxx/noScribe/wiki/Add-custom-Whisper-models-for-transcription

title: Custom Models (Whisper)
content:
Custom Models (Whisper)#This page summarizes the wiki guide for adding custom Whisper models. For the latest details, see the original source below.
Quick steps (as per wiki)#In noScribe, open Model > Add AI model… to open the model folder. Create one subfolder per model. The folder name becomes the model name in the UI. Only Faster-Whisper/CTranslate2 models are supported. OpenAI-format models must be converted first. Put the model files in the subfolder (typically: config.json, model.bin, preprocessor_config.json, tokenizer.json, vocabulary.json). The model should then appear in noScribe. Paths (as per wiki)#Windows: C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\noScribe\noScribe\whisper_models\ macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/noscribe/whisper_models/ Linux: TODO (not explicitly listed in the wiki) Model sources (as per wiki)#Faster-Whisper models (Systran), including Whisper v2 Language-specific models (e.g., French or German) If filenames include a ctranslate2_ prefix, remove it (e.g., ctranslate2_vocabulary.json → vocabulary.json). The German model additionally requires tokenizer.json from the original Whisper v3 repository. Source#Original wiki: https://github.com/kaixxx/noScribe/wiki/Add-custom-Whisper-models-for-transcription

title: noScribe
content:
noScribe#noScribe is an open-source transcription app for interviews, qualitative research, and journalism. Transcription runs locally on your machine and is based on Whisper, faster-whisper, and pyannote (per the project README).
Download & Installation GitHub Releases Code & technical docs
Why noScribe?#Offline-first: No cloud uploads, no account required. Open source: GPL-3.0, transparent and future-proof. Multilingual: 60+ languages according to the README. Speaker identification: Associate segments with speakers (per README). Built-in editor: Review and correct transcripts in the app. Privacy by design#This website uses no cookies, no tracking, and no external requests. noScribe itself is designed as a local desktop app and processes audio offline.
Who is it for?#Interview transcription in research & teaching Journalism workflows Qualitative studies and analysis Project and field notes Name clarification#Commercial third-party products with a similar name exist and are not affiliated with this open-source project.
